events.evidence: Three suicide bombers attack a Shiite mosque in Kandahar, Afghanistan, killing 47 people and injuring 70 others.
David Amess, United Kingdom MP for Southend West, is stabbed to death in Leigh-on-Sea, Essex
India is expected to reopen its borders to overseas travellers as it relaxes COVID-19-related restrictions

label.note: Kandahar mosque bombing and murder of UK MP dominate; COVID reopenings are supportive but secondary.
